fields.description: When on, the public Test / Dissemination form at /anticipatory-action-test is live and a Testing Environment button + Test Data widget appear in the admin console. Test submissions never count towards real metrics or the dashboard.
fields.label: Testing / dissemination mode enabled

fields.description: Name this round of testing, e.g. "Garissa testing 2026". Every entry submitted through the test form while testing is on is tagged with this batch.
fields.label: Test batch name

fields.description: Branded AA emails (welcome, sign-up, pillar enquiries) are sent FROM this address. Format: "Name <email@domain>" or just "email@domain". The email part MUST match the Email ID of an Email Account set up for outgoing. Leave blank to use the built-in default, Anticipatory Action <aadashboard@ndoc.go.ke>.
fields.label: AA email sender (From)
